FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION (FDA)  

  Regulatory Support Services BPA  

  SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE (SSN)  

  

   Description    

  

 The U.S. Food and Drug Administration's (FDA), Office of Acquisitions and Grants Services (OAGS), is conducting market research for obtaining Regulatory Support Services. 

  

   THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE (SSN) ONLY  . This SSN is being issued in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10, Market Research. It is for information, planning and market research purposes only and is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or ultimately award a contract. This notice does not obligate the Government to award a contract or otherwise pay for the information provided in response. Respondents are advised that the Government is under no obligation to acknowledge receipt of the information received or provide feedback to respondents with respect to any information submitted. The Government reserves the right to contact any of the respondents after the submission deadline if additional information is required. 

  

 The purpose of this SSN is to identify and gain knowledge of potential business sources and small business sources that are capable of providing the full range of services described in this SSN and the attached    Draft    Statement of Work (SOW). Responses to this SSN will be utilized for a potential solicitation for an anticipated stand-alone BPA for Regulatory Support Services Program. The anticipated period of performance for this contract is a Fiscal Year 2027 award with a base year, plus four (4) option years),  with a potential 6-month extension of services pursuant to FAR 52.217-8.  

  

   Requested Information   

  

 Interested parties are highly encouraged to respond to this SSN by providing the following information in their response: 

 
	 Completed Vendor Feedback Form  –  See attached Vendor Feedback Form   
	 If applicable, tracked changes/comments on draft SOW in MS Word format  –  See attached D raft      SOW   
	 Capability Statement 
 

 Responses shall be submitted via email with the subject line "Sources Sought Notice - FDA SSN: CTP-2027-136871” to the Contracting Officer, Nicholas Bisher (Nicholas.Bisher@fda.hhs.gov),   no later than 5:00pm (Eastern) on November 24, 2026.   

  

   Attachments
